definitions.compression_opportunity: fine_state_count > coarse_state_count on the frozen common frame
definitions.pair_collision_gain: q_coarse - q_fine, where q is exact without-replacement same-state pair probability

questions: Is zero compression opportunity sufficient to force zero scale tilt?
Among clades with compression opportunity, is realized tilt systematically positive?
Among opportunity clades, does the magnitude of state compression determine signed or absolute tilt?
Does fine-state richness affect scale tilt without affecting overall memory amplitude?

primary_descriptive_tests.opportunity_subset_tilt: one-sided Wilcoxon and sign test of scale_tilt > 0 among opportunity clades
primary_descriptive_tests.amplitude_specificity: Spearman fine_state_count vs memory amplitude across all 28 clades

claim_boundary: compression opportunity is a structural prerequisite, not a causal ecological mechanism
